title: ISSUE_419_DECISION_PACKET
universal_lens: Calibration artifact revision via evidence shrinkage and market anchoring in v5.2.6 introduces a conformal predictive probability framework with adaptive eligibility blending. A conformal predictive system integrates model-freeze verification with live calibration through Bayesian blending and shadow pipeline accumulation.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian calibration updates through live eligibility probabilities using shrinkage factors and market-weighted independence in GSI's probabilistic inference engine. GSI employs Bayesian inference to update belief states using calibrated evidence from settled outcomes, leveraging the model-freeze guardrail as a prior constraint.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning in GSE employs state transitions based on calibrated evidence thresholds and blended confidence-market signals for decision-making. GSE applies situational reasoning to transition system states by evaluating empirical deltas from the shadow pipeline against implemented artifacts in real-time.
